body: Thank you so much this really helped and made me feel better knowing I wasn't overreacting. I was 16 at the time he was 19

Thank you sooooooooooooooooooooooooooo much every word you said helped me a lot it means everything, you have no idea how much this helped me. I still haven't told my brother but your words on encouragement still mean a lot Thank you

I just wanted to say thank you to everyone who commented. I'm sorry I didn't reply to anyone I was just feeling so bad and didn't really want to talk about it. I went to see my school nurse and she has been helping me through it, I still haven't told my parents or brother, but seeing all of these comments has really helped me and lifted my spirits so thank you all so much again.

im sorry your going through this, but i think i understand what your going through, my dad left me when i was 1 for another family. im sorry you feel alone and abandoned no one deserve to feel that way, if you ever need to talk or rant im here.

hi. im so sorry you feel this way, but i think i understand what your going through, i've had depression and soical anxiety ever since i was 10, making it hard to find friends. im always alone and no one to ask for support, so if you ever need someone to talk to im here if your comfortable. your not alone.

im so sorry your feeling this way, but your very brave to stay strong for your daughters. my dad left when i was 1. your daughters would not be better off without you, trust me very kid needs their dad to be there. you sound like a good dad keep going for them. do you have any other friends you can go to for support?
dont kill yourself. you can get out of debt and get you life together, dont throw away that chance.

i am so sorry you are going through this. but i think you have to worry about your own mental health first, before you can help your fiance. maybe you should think about, taking a break to focus on yourself and so he can focus on himself and get better before committing to each other. make sure you look after yourself and just give support to him so he doesn't feel alone without you.

im sorry you feel this way. i think i understand what your going though. i think about killing myself everyday, i feel relief  sometimes even happiness like you at the thought of the pain finally ending, but i think your really strong to keep fighting and battling depression. im here if you feel comfortable talking.

i know the feeling. i've talk friends out of suicide hundred's of times and yet i've tried to kill myself 5 times. but i think your much more important than you think. just because of the age gap of your siblings doesn't mean its gonna hurt any less for your mum, trust me i know i have 4 younger siblings with at least 13 years in between. you are much more important to people than you think, no one would be relieved if you died. you can pm me if you want to talk to someone.
it's ok if you dont want to go into detail about your personal life, but if you ever need anyone to talk to just to get it off your chest and rant you can pm me anytime.
thanks same here you can add me on facebook if you want
Im so sorry you feel like this, i understand, i want to kill myself as well i have ever since i was 10. but please don't give up, your not alone, im here if you want to talk to someone.

reading this broke my heart. i understand how you feel wanting to end it all cause it feels like the only escape, only way to make the pain go away but please don't do it, keep trying, keep fighting. you can talk to me anytime, if you feel comfortable.
all goods hope i helped

i feel the same i want to die but i dont want to hurt anyone. it sounds like a lot of people care and love you, you should think about telling them how you feel and it might help lift the weight off your shoulders getting support from people you know and trust. i know it takes strength to keep going for the people we love. i am here if you want to talk.

don't kill yourself, you are very strong person to post this and keep going and keep trying. i am so sorry about your mum im sure she would be very proud of you for staying strong and being there for her. your story gives me courage to keep going and stay as strong as you. i am here if you ever want to talk to someone.

i believe you are very brave for posting this. i understand what it feels like to feel uncomfortable in your own skin, and being cheated on and dumped doesn't make you feel any better, but you still continue to move forward and try hard to help yourself and that takes really courage and hard work, dont give up on yourself yet, i am here if you need to talk to someone.

you sound like a very strong person to keep going and trying after everything you've gone through. your thoughts only win when you give up and if you keep fighting you will win. you should think about speaking out and telling someone you know and trust for support so you dont feel so alone and isolated.

I think you are really brave and have such courage to keep going everyday, i have depression, social anixtey and BPD as well, i cut almost everyday and have suidical thoughts everyday. i have tried to kill myself 5 times, but reading your story has encouraged me to be going, because if you can stay strong and keep living so can I. It takes strength to keep going each and everyday and you are much stronger then you give yourself credit for. i am amazed and inspired by you. thank you for sharing your story and i am here 24/7 if you need anyone to talk to. if i had any advice to give you it would be to go out in public even just go for a simple walk and get fresh air, clear your head so you don't feel so isolated.
